narr: A push of monsoon moisture fueled thunderstorms over southern Nevada. Several storms produced severe winds and flash flooding.
ev: Major flooding in Logandale and Overton due to heavy rainfall and flow on the Muddy River. Evacuations, sand bag operations, and at least two water rescues occurred. Water was four to five feet deep in some neighborhoods, railroad tracks were closed due to flood damage, many roads were flooded, and there were power outages.
lsr: FLASH FLOOD - 12-18 INCHES OF WATER FLOWING ACROSS THE ROAD AT THE CORNER OF GUBLER AVE AND HEYER ST. IN LOGANDALE.
